name: SurveyFlip
description:
SurveyFlip is a survey platform for teams who need answers quickly. This connector lets Claude work with your SurveyFlip account directly in conversation.

Ask Claude to draft a survey and it builds one for you, choosing question types and writing the options. Twelve question types are supported, including multiple choice, rating and opinion scales, boolean, dropdown, short and long text, email, phone, country, and name fields. You review the draft, ask for changes in plain language, and publish when it's ready. Claude returns a public link you can send to respondents.

Once responses start arriving, ask Claude what people said. It reads completed responses and reports views, starts, completions, quota, and completion rate, so you can summarise open-text answers or compare results across questions without exporting anything.

Surveys can be taken back to draft, edited, and republished at any time. Collected responses are preserved.

Requires a SurveyFlip account. A free account is sufficient.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SurveyFlip to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SurveyFlip to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.surveyflip.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SurveyFlip MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SurveyFlip lists 14 MCP tools, including add_question, create_survey, delete_survey, get_share_link, get_survey, list_question_types, list_responses, list_surveys, publish_survey, survey_stats, unpublish_survey, and update_question.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SurveyFlip?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SurveyFlip in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SurveyFlip requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SurveyFlip is developed by IVIVE LABS LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
